name: Opinion System
positioning: Le tiers de confiance qui certifie la réputation des professionnels, avec une méthode d'avis contrôlés triple certifiée AFNOR.
description: Opinion System is a French polling institute that collects and controls customer reviews for several regulated professions, including real estate. Its collection method is AFNOR-certified (ISO 9001, ISO 20252, NF Service 522, NF ISO 20488): reviews are verified before publication through a process audited every year.
description_fr: Opinion System est un institut de sondage français qui collecte et contrôle des avis clients pour plusieurs professions réglementées, dont l'immobilier. Sa méthode de collecte est certifiée AFNOR (ISO 9001, ISO 20252, NF Service 522, NF ISO 20488) : les avis sont vérifiés avant publication par un processus audité chaque année.
real_estate_use: A real estate agency or credit broker signs up with Opinion System to get its customer reviews certified: the platform solicits clients after a transaction, checks review authenticity before publication, and the agency displays the certified-reputation badge on its site to reassure new prospects.
features: Sector-specific version for real estate and credit brokerage

use_cases.job: Certify customer reputation to reassure new prospects
